rationale: Price is at 98.3% of today's range, just $0.19 below the session high of $87.90, after a 14.69% gap-up on strong earnings. The last five 1-minute candles show stalling momentum with declining volume and a slight drift lower from the $87.33 open of that sequence, suggesting exhaustion near the high rather than a clean breakout. With only 55 minutes to close, the risk/reward for a long at the top of a large gap-up range is poor, and a short against a strong earnings catalyst and rising 9-EMA ($87.11) carries equal risk — no high-probability setup exists in either direction.
